research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Gusto is advancing its cloud-based payroll and HR management solutions through several innovations. They are developing a central database system for managing human resources functions, allowing entities to execute employer functions and manage employee information efficiently. This includes user provisioning management and personal information database modification. Additionally, Gusto is enhancing security by tagging and auditing sensitive information and improving user experience with predictive web navigation and machine-learned database models. These efforts highlight Gusto's focus on optimizing HR processes and data security.

product.name: Payroll
product.description: Cloud-based payroll software for calculating pay, deductions, direct deposits, payroll taxes, tax filings, compliance support, and contractor payments.

product.name: Employee Benefits
product.description: Benefits administration for employer-sponsored health insurance, retirement plans, automatic savings, and other employee financial benefits.

product.name: HR
product.description: Human resources software for employee records, onboarding, talent management, compliance tasks, and other people-operations workflows.

product.name: Hiring and Onboarding
product.description: Recruiting and onboarding tools for job and applicant tracking, offer letters, employee self-onboarding, checklists, and software setup.

product.name: Time and Attendance
product.description: Time-tracking and time-off management software that records hours, PTO, holidays, and requests and synchronizes approved data with payroll.

product.name: Gusto Global
product.description: Global workforce tools for paying international contractors and hiring employees in other countries, with related payroll and compliance workflows.
